en: Crops were raised by students to pay for their upkeep and the costs of infrastructure. Language lessons were dispensed in rickety buildings with chronic shortages of desks, chairs, and school supplies.

While common schools for Han students faced financial constraints because they were paid for with local taxes levied on colonized Taiwanese, the indigenous schools faced even tougher constraints because they were funded by a central government that was perpetually cash-starved.
zh: 学生种庄稼来支付自己的给养与基础设施开销。语言课在摇摇欲坠的房屋里进行，课桌、椅子与学习用品长期短缺。
汉人学生的公学校因靠向被殖民台湾人征收的地方税支付而面临财政拮据，原住民学校则面临更严峻的拮据，因为它们由一个永远手头缺钱的中央政府出资。

en: With the arrival of Taiwan’s first civilian governor-general, Den Kenjirō, in 1921, a few highly qualified and ambitious Han and indigenous students were permitted to enter elementary schools with Japanese children. In 1921, eight indigenous students throughout Taiwan met the tough standards. The denigrating word “savage” was dropped from the name of the aborigine common schools in 1922, but the course of study remained restricted to four years of practical education. The exceptions who proved the rule were children of Japanese policemen and indigenous women who entered the elementary school in Wushe alongside Japanese schoolchildren. Most indigene school attendees—themselves a slight percentage of the total population—went to the Wushe aborigine common school. This was the only common school for indigenous children for all of northern and central Taiwan; all other Truku, Sediq, and Atayal children, if they attended at all, were taught at Japanese police stations.
zh: 1921年，随着台湾首位文官总督田健治郎到任，少数资质优异、雄心勃勃的汉人与原住民学生获准与日本儿童同入小学。1921年，全台湾有八名原住民学生达到了严苛的标准。1922年，贬损性的“蕃”字从蕃人公学校的名称中去掉了，但学业仍限于四年的实用教育。恰恰说明常规何其严格的例外，是日本警察与原住民女子所生的孩子，他们与日本学童一同进入雾社的小学。大多数原住民在校生——本身只占总人口的极小比例——就读于雾社蕃人公学校。这是整个北台湾与中台湾唯一一所面向原住民儿童的公学校；所有其他德路固、赛德克与泰雅儿童，即便上学，也是在警察驻在所里受教。
body.review: 原书把田健治郎到任写在1921年。台湾文献馆所载施政演说与任命资料表明他于1919年到任；本段所述1921年八名原住民学生的数据依原书保留。

en: Two Wushe common-school graduates, Hōgō natives Hanaoka Ichirō (Dakis Nobing) and Hanaoka Jirō (Dakis Nawi), entered the Puli elementary school as teenagers in 1921. Puli was a walled city and gateway to the mountain settlements in central Taiwan. The two subsequently took jobs as a school instructor and a police assistant, respectively, near Wushe, and became famous for the suicide note they left on the morning of the October 27, 1930, Wushe Rebellion.

While they were not directly implicated in the attacks, they blamed “excessive forced labor” for the rebellion and reported that they had “been detained against [their] will by the barbarians.” The passionately scrawled note criticized both sides, reflecting the painfully torn identity of men who had ascended the meritocratic ladder but also identified with the people they had left behind.
zh: 两名雾社公学校毕业生、荷戈人花冈一郎（达基斯·诺宾）与花冈二郎（达基斯·纳维），于1921年十几岁时进入埔里小学。埔里是一座城池，也是通往中台湾山地聚落的门户。两人随后分别在雾社附近谋得学校教员与警手的职位，并因1930年10月27日雾社起义当天早晨留下的遗书而闻名。
他们虽未直接牵连进袭击，却把起义归咎于“过度强制劳役”，并报告说自己“违背〔我们的〕意愿被野蛮人扣留”。这封激情潦草的遗书批评了双方，反映出一种痛苦撕裂的身份认同：他们凭才干获得晋升，却仍认同自己甩在身后的族人。

en: The Hanaokas (not related) had married local Hōgō women at a Japanese-style wedding ceremony near a government office in the 1920s. Their wives, Kawano Hanako (Obing Nawi) and Takayama Hatsuko (Obing Tado) were the daughter and niece of a leading Sediq political figure, the Hōgō paramount chieftain (sōtōmoku) Tadao Nōkan. Hanako and Hatsuko were frequently photographed in Japanese clothing and attended the Puli elementary school, like their husbands. According to Deng Xiangyang, these marriages were arranged by the government to provide examples of successful assimilation by indigenous peoples.
zh: 花冈两人（并无亲属关系）于1920年代在一处政府机关附近，以日式婚礼娶了当地荷戈女子。他们的妻子河野花子（奥宾·纳维）与高山初子（奥宾·塔多），是赛德克一位重要政治人物、荷戈最高头目（总头目，sōtōmoku）达道·诺坎的女儿与侄女。花子与初子常穿着日本服装拍照，并像丈夫一样就读埔里小学。据邓相扬说，这些婚姻是政府安排的，用以提供原住民成功同化的范例。

en: The rumors of the two Hanaokas’ complicity in the October 27, 1930, slaughter of Japanese civilians and police in the model indigenous administrative hub of Wushe suggested that too much education for indigenous peoples would only produce malcontents. Matsuda Yoshirō has written that after the 1930 uprising, indigenous peoples were no longer permitted to enroll in advanced educational institutes.

Kitamura Kae’s statistics show that in the 1920s, fewer than ten students from the indigenous territory per year were selected to attend the elementary schools; by 1930 there were only twenty-eight total indigenous graduates of elementary, middle, normal, nursing, medical, and women’s schools combined.

But the more important trend was the content, context, and purpose of indigenous education in the post-Wushe years, which shaded into the full-blown mobilization period after 1936. If the Taishō period can be characterized by the vocational bent of indigenous education, the Shōwa years featured an emphasis on spiritual transformation and imperial subjectification.
zh: 关于两名花冈共谋参与1930年10月27日在雾社这个模范原住民行政枢纽屠杀日本平民与警察的传言，暗示给原住民太多教育只会造就不满分子。松田吉郎写道，1930年起义之后，原住民不再获准进入高等教育机构。
北村嘉惠的统计显示，1920年代每年从原住民领土选拔进入小学的学生不足十人；到1930年，小学、中学、师范、护理、医学与女子学校的原住民毕业生合计仅二十八人。
但更重要的趋势，是雾社之后岁月里原住民教育的内容、语境与目的，它逐渐过渡到1936年后全面展开的动员时期。如果说大正时期可以原住民教育的职业导向为特征，昭和年代则突出精神改造与皇民化。

en: Inspector Yokoo Hirosuke took a leading role in framing post-Wushe policies for the indigenous areas. Yokoo obliquely referred to the “Hanaoka” syndrome with a reference to French colonial education in Africa. Yokoo believed that the French were moving too quickly on their assimilation policies. Therefore, the African educated elite returned to home villages resenting their own countries. Some suffered the anomie that bedeviled proletarian intellectuals in other colonies. Yokoo was not against education per se. He insisted that its quality and extent be improved and that Japanese-language training be more thorough. Yokoo stated his belief that indigenes should internalize and themselves propagate loyalty to the emperor and a sense of imperial mission. Somewhat paradoxically, Yokoo emphasized respect for the indigenous character (although he called for the reform, if not eradication, of many indigenous practices). While he was an advocate for imperial subjectification, Yokoo also believed that indigenous education should not exceed the cultural capacities of its targets.
zh: 警部横尾广助在制定雾社后原住民地区政策方面起了主导作用。横尾借法国在非洲的殖民教育，含蓄地提及“花冈”综合征。横尾认为法国人在同化政策上推进得太快。因此，非洲受教育的精英回到家乡后怨恨自己的国家。有些人遭遇了那种困扰其他殖民地无产阶级知识分子的失范。横尾并不反对教育本身。他坚持要提升教育的质量与广度，日语训练要更彻底。横尾表明他相信，原住民应当内化并自行传播对天皇的忠诚与帝国使命感。颇为矛盾的是，横尾强调尊重原住民特性（尽管他呼吁改革乃至根除许多原住民习俗）。他虽是皇民化的倡导者，却也认为原住民教育不应超出其对象的文化能力。

en: TGG policies indeed reflected the twin priorities of imperialization and respect for indigenous particularity in the 1930s. The period saw decreasing expenditures per indigenous student for education

but also saw renewed efforts to propagate Japanese language through other forms of schooling, including ubiquitous night schools attached to police boxes. One official estimate in 1937 put the overall “can understand basic Japanese for everyday tasks” rate for indigenes at 34 percent for males and 24 percent for females. Among Atayal peoples (Atayal, Truku, Sediq), these numbers were 40 percent and 32 percent, respectively. By 1942, roughly 50 percent of all indigenous peoples were proficient in conversational Japanese, with 58 percent of Atayal men reaching that level of proficiency.
zh: 1930年代，台湾总督府的政策确实反映了皇民化与尊重原住民特殊性这双重优先。这一时期，每名原住民学生的教育支出递减，
却也重新努力通过其他办学形式传播日语，包括附设于警察派出所、无处不在的夜校。1937年一份官方估计，把原住民“能听懂日常事务的基本日语”的总体比率定为男性34%、女性24%。在泰雅诸族（泰雅、德路固、赛德克）中，这两个数字分别为40%与32%。到1942年，约50%的原住民能熟练进行日语会话，泰雅男子达到这一熟练程度的有58%。

en: As indigenous proficiency in Japanese increased during the 1920s through the 1940s, the Taiwan Government-General hollowed out the incentive structure for Japanese policemen to learn indigenous languages. Before 1922 all policemen who passed a language test received stipends, but after 1931 that number decreased to 90 percent for a minority of “
” policemen and to only 20–30 percent of the majority “

” Austronesian language speakers. Diminishing incentives were reflected in low proficiency rates: in the 1930s, only 2.5 percent of indigenous district policemen were fluent in a local language, while 26 percent were merely proficient. That meant that about one in twelve dispatch stations had an officer fluent in a local language. But since the percentage of lower-ranking Japanese patrolmen in the indigenous area also decreased, while the number of indigenous policemen increased to about 50 percent of the police force,
the number of bilingual indigenous policemen actually increased; they just weren’t Japanese.
zh: 随着1920年代至1940年代原住民日语熟练度提高，台湾总督府逐步削弱了鼓励日本警察学习原住民语言的津贴制度。1922年之前，凡通过语言测试的警察都领津贴，但1931年之后，这一比例降为：少数“流利”警察的90%，以及大多数“熟练”南岛语使用者的仅20%—30%。激励递减反映在低熟练率上：1930年代，原住民地区警察中只有2.5%流利掌握一门当地语言，26%仅止于熟练。这意味着约每十二处分遣所才有一处拥有一名流利掌握当地语言的警官。但由于原住民地区低阶日本巡查的比例也下降了，而原住民警察的数量增至警力的约50%，
双语原住民警察的人数实际上增加了——只不过他们不是日本人。

en: During the period that I have characterized as falling under “native authority,” circa 1910 to 1930, cross-cultural communication was anchored by female indigenous relatives of influential headmen who married Japanese policemen. The problems encountered by Kondō Gisaburō, Sazuka Aisuke, and Shimoyama Jihei revealed that system’s limitations and contradictions. The reliance on chiefs not only circumscribed the influence and knowledge of policemen attached to them, but as we saw in chapter 1, the older generation of headmen themselves were unreliable vectors of public power. Therefore, after Wushe, they were replaced by new leadership: the indigenous youth corps (
zh: 在我界定为处于“土著权威”之下的那段时期，约1910年至1930年，跨文化沟通由那些嫁给日本警察的、有影响力头目的女性原住民亲属所锚定。近藤仪三郎、佐塚爱祐与下山治平所遭遇的问题，暴露了那一体制的局限与矛盾。依赖头目不仅限制了附属于他们的警察的影响力与知识，而且正如我们在第1章所见，老一代头目本身就是公共权力不可靠的载体。因此，雾社之后，他们被新的领导层取代：原住民青年团（高砂族青年团，Takasagozoku seinendan）。

en: These new youth leaders were called “pioneers” (
). They replaced the tōmoku and

(headmen and men of influence) as the intermediaries between Japanese officialdom and the Taiwan Indigenous Peoples. With the advent of a new indigenous leadership recruited from aborigine youth schools, a less locally embedded intermediary cohort emerged. This new leadership was groomed to lead a society of farmers, stockbreeders, and fishermen who were destined, if Japanese colonial rulers had any say in the matter, to live their lives out in the indigenous territory. There was no question of integrating the highland economy with the rest of Taiwan. After the Wushe Rebellion, it was determined at the highest levels of government in Taiwan that Taiwan Indigenous Peoples could only thrive under the paternalistic care of a functionally specialized aborigine administration.
zh: 这些新的青年领袖被称为“先驱者”（senkusha）。他们取代头目与势力者（tōmoku 与 seiryokusha，即头人与有影响力者），成为日本官方与台湾原住民之间的中介。随着一支从蕃童教育所招募的新原住民领导层登场，一个不那么深嵌于地方的中介群体出现了。这一新领导层被培养去领导一个由农夫、畜牧者与渔民组成的社会——如果日本殖民统治者在这件事上有任何发言权的话，这些人注定要在原住民领土内终其一生。把山地经济与台湾其余部分整合起来根本不在考虑之列。雾社起义之后，台湾政府最高层认定，台湾原住民只有在一个功能专门化的蕃务行政的家长式照护下才能兴旺。

en: As Japanese became the language of governance within the indigenous territory, Japanese policemen were rotated more freely over the surface of the territory. But their new ethos and sense of professional identity tied them to the second-order geobody of indigenous Taiwan. The new role of indigenous women in the post-Wushe era is perhaps best symbolized by the famous Atayal heroine Sayon. In September 1938, Sayon and ten other Atayal women were helping a local Japanese policeman named Takita cross a river to get to his military post and join the war in China. Weighed down with three of his suitcases, Sayon herself fell in and drowned, becoming a martyr and the subject of song, film, a memorial bell, and more.
The seventeen-year-old Sayon was neither an interpreter cohabiting with Takita nor a leader in war on the order of Iwan Robao or Tata Rara.
zh: 随着日语成为原住民领土内的治理语言，日本警察得以在这片领土上更自由地轮换。但他们新的精神气质与职业认同感，把他们系在了原住民台湾这个二阶地理体上。雾社后时代原住民女性的新角色，或许以著名的泰雅女杰沙韵为最佳象征。1938年9月，沙韵与另外十名泰雅女子帮一名叫泷田的当地日本警察渡河，去赴他的军职、参加在中国的战争。沙韵自己背着他的三只行李箱，负重落水溺亡，成了殉难者，也成了歌曲、电影、纪念钟等等的题材。
十七岁的沙韵既不是与泷田同居的通译，也不是堪比伊娃莉·罗拔俄或达达·拉拉那样的战争领袖。

en: Instead, she was carrying luggage to help a mobile, uniformed, male agent of Japanese empire exit her village peacefully. While many treatments of Sayon emphasize the hoopla generated by her supposed spirit of sacrifice, she was essentially a porter. In fact, as the indigenous territories became sites of ethnic tourism in the 1930s, the luggage-carrying indigenous woman became a common sight.
zh: 相反，她是在搬运行李，帮一个流动的、着制服的、男性的日本帝国代理人平静地离开她的村子。虽然许多关于沙韵的论述强调她所谓牺牲精神所引发的喧嚣炒作，她本质上却是一名脚夫。事实上，随着1930年代原住民领土成为族群观光之地，搬行李的原住民女子成了常见景象。

en: To be sure, the “normal administration” that indigenes were being excluded from meant heavy taxes, floggings by policemen without a trial (until 1921), and discrimination in public schools, administrative jobs, and the police force. Moreover, public education in the normally administered territories was far from universal or equal to the quality of education for children of Japanese colonists. Only 2.19 percent of school-age Taiwanese children attended schools in 1900. The rate reached 4.66 percent in 1905 and 5.67 percent in 1910.
By 1930, however, the rate was 30 percent, and by 1940, 60 percent.
zh: 诚然，原住民被排除在外的“普通行政”，意味着重税、警察未经审判的鞭笞（直到1921年），以及在公立学校、行政职位与警力中的歧视。此外，普通行政区内的公共教育远未普及，质量也远不及日本殖民者子女所受的教育。1900年，只有2.19%的台湾学龄儿童在校。这一比率1905年达4.66%，1910年达5.67%。

en: Even after Gotō’s administration put an end to large-scale armed Han resistance in 1902, rebellions continued through 1915. In 1907 rebels led by Cai Qingrin killed twenty-four TGG policemen and frontier sentries in the “Beipu incident.” The next day, insurgents killed all Japanese residents of Beipu town, for a total of fifty-seven fatalities in two days. The government-general killed about ninety rebels in its suppression sweeps. Over one hundred suspected rebels were arrested; nine were sentenced to death, and ninety-seven were either confined or put on corvée labor. Other planned rebellions were discovered before they came to fruition in 1912 and 1914. The hundreds of conspirators apprehended, however, suggests that Han-dominated lowland Taiwan could not be classified as a disciplinary society before World War I, insofar as brute force was required to maintain order.
zh: 即便后藤施政于1902年终结了大规模汉人武装抵抗，叛乱仍持续到1915年。1907年，蔡清琳率领的叛乱者在“北埔事件”中杀了二十四名台湾总督府警察与边疆哨兵。次日，起事者杀光了北埔镇的所有日本居民，两天内共五十七人丧生。总督府在镇压扫荡中杀了约九十名叛乱者。一百多名疑似叛乱者被捕；九人被判死刑，九十七人或被监禁、或服劳役。其他策划中的起事在1912年和1914年还未付诸行动就被发现。然而，数百名同谋者落网，表明在第一次世界大战之前，汉人主导的台湾低地尚不能被归为规训社会，因为维持秩序仍需蛮力。

en: The Ta-pa-ni or Xilai’an incident of 1915 marked the last spasm of Han armed resistance.
Former colonial policeman Yu Qingfang (1879–1915) and associates led this millenarian uprising. According to Paul Katz, author of a definitive social history,

” the number of Taiwanese and Japanese killed during the fighting [was] estimated to have exceeded 1,000 people. A further 1,957 Taiwanese were arrested... of whom 1,482 were put on trial and 915 sentenced to death. A total of 135 Taiwanese were executed before the Taishō Emperor issued a decree of clemency, while scores more died in prison.”
zh: 1915年的噍吧哖（西来庵）事件标志着汉人武装抵抗的最后一次大规模爆发。
前殖民警察余清芳（1879—1915）及其同伙领导了这场带有千禧年信仰的起义。据一部权威社会史的作者康豹所述，
“战斗中被打死的台湾人与日本人〔据〕估计超过1000人。另有1957名台湾人被捕……其中1482人受审、915人被判死刑。在大正天皇颁布宽赦令之前，共有135名台湾人被处决，另有数十人死于狱中。”

en: Han armed resistance never again reached the scale and intensity of the Beipu and Ta-pa-ni revolts. According to Caroline Hui-yu Ts’ai, by “1920, when the colonial administration of Taiwan delegated part of its power to local governments... structural integration by and large had been completed.” In other words, over a two-decade period of experimentation, the Taiwan Government-General had effectively co-opted the

system for taxation and vital statistics while mobilizing it to make even Taiwan’s rural population visible and amenable to policing and labor mobilization. Despite the coextension of territorially defined Japanese policing units (gun) with local self-responsibility units (

) throughout Taiwan, Ts’ai concludes that structural “integration... did not necessarily result in social integration. It took the two decades of the interwar period... for the colonial administration to appropriate Taiwanese society for its use.”
zh: 汉人武装抵抗再未达到北埔与噍吧哖起义的规模与强度。据蔡慧玉说，到“1920年，当台湾殖民当局把部分权力下放给地方政府时……结构整合大体已完成。”换言之，在二十年的试验期里，台湾总督府已有效地把保甲体制收编用于征税与人口动态统计，同时动员它，使连台湾的乡村人口也变得可见、可纳入治安与劳力动员。尽管按领土界定的日本治安单位（郡，gun）与地方连带责任单位（保甲）在全台湾重合，蔡慧玉仍总结说，结构上的“整合……未必带来社会整合。殖民当局花了两次大战之间那二十年……才把台湾社会收为己用。”

en: Nonetheless, in comparison to the indigenous territories, lowland Taiwan can be said to have become a disciplinary society in many respects. After the Ta-pa-ni rebellion was put down, normal administration began to diverge more sharply from special administration. By 1915, the year the reader for indigenes was published, a middle school had been established for Han Taiwanese. A few vocational schools were added after 1919 and a university (with only rare seats for Taiwanese) in 1928. Despite its restrictive and discriminatory nature, the Japanese education system for Han Taiwanese was robust enough to foment “major changes in the structure of Taiwanese elites. In the 1910s, the landlords and gentry... had begun to give way to the rising groups of professionals trained in colonial institutions.”

Over the next two decades, the court system, especially for commercial law, became more equitable; corporal punishment was abolished; and a great number of rights guaranteed by the Meiji constitution for citizens on the main four islands were extended to Taiwanese under regular administration.
zh: 尽管如此，与原住民领土相比，台湾低地在许多方面可以说已成为规训社会。噍吧哖起义被镇压后，普通行政开始与特别行政更鲜明地分化。到1915年，即《蕃人读本》出版那年，已为台湾汉人设立了一所中学。1919年后增设了几所职业学校，1928年又设了一所大学（台湾人只有极少数名额）。尽管具有排他与歧视的性质，面向台湾汉人的日本教育体制仍足够强健，足以促成“台湾精英结构的重大变化。1910年代，地主与士绅……已开始让位于在殖民机构中受训的新兴专业人士群体。”
此后二十年，法院体系——尤其是商法方面——变得更公平；肉刑被废除；明治宪法为本土四岛公民保障的许多权利，也扩展到了普通行政区的台湾人。

en: Although social mobility through education for Taiwanese was restricted to medicine and education, it was structurally homologous to Japan’s home-island system. Most students would obtain basic, functional literacy and morals education, and a small percentage of the population would be trained to lead the rest of society. Under colonial rule, these leaders were supposed to be models for collaboration and assimilation, but many led movements that challenged TGG prerogatives. The formation of a Taiwanese political class capable of mobilizing a petition movement for home rule and equal treatment in Japan had developed by 1914. This large-scale civil-society activism attests to the power of precolonial educational traditions and the strength of island-wide networks among Han Taiwanese. But the nonviolent political resistance movements of the 1920s and 1930s, as Ming-cheng M. Lo has demonstrated, evolved in the colonial school system. In contrast, residents in the specially administered districts did not mount petition movements, establish opposition newspapers, or lobby the government in Tokyo. Instead, they attacked, burned, and looted exposed police boxes or Japanese settlements on occasion, most infamously on October 27, 1930.
zh: 虽然台湾人通过教育实现的社会流动限于医学与教育，它在结构上却与日本本土诸岛的体制相似。大多数学生获得基础的实用识字与修身教育，一小部分人口则被训练去领导社会其余成员。在殖民统治下，这些领袖本应是合作与同化的楷模，但许多人却领导了挑战台湾总督府特权的运动。到1914年，一个能够组织请愿运动，向日本争取台湾地方自治与平等待遇的台湾人政治阶级已经形成。这种大规模公民社会行动主义，证明了殖民前教育传统的力量，以及台湾汉人全岛网络的强韧。但正如骆明正所揭示的，1920与1930年代的非暴力政治抵抗运动，是在殖民学校体制中演化出来的。相比之下，特别行政区的居民没有发起请愿运动、创办反对派报纸，或向东京政府游说。相反，他们偶尔袭击、焚烧、劫掠无防护的警察派出所或日本聚落，其中最臭名昭著的一次便是1930年10月27日。

en: The Margary affair of February 21, 1875, which occurred within three months of Japan’s departure from Taiwan, provides yet another example of how deadly violence, inflicted by peoples within the Qing empire but beyond its administered territories, could become an occasion for a costly foreign intervention with long-term consequences for the Qing. In this case, the death of a single British functionary at the hands of Burmese hill tribes brought the full weight of the British crown to bear on the Qing court, resulting in a round of treaty negotiations and public-apology missions. See James Hevia,

zh: 1875年2月21日的马嘉理事件，发生在日本撤出台湾后三个月内，提供了又一个例证，说明清帝国内部、但在其行政领土之外的民族所施加的致命暴力，如何可能成为一场代价高昂、并对清朝产生长期后果的外国干预的契机。在此例中，一名英国官员死于缅甸山地部落之手，便招致英国王室的全部压力压向清廷，结果是一轮条约谈判与公开道歉使团。见 [James Hevia, English Lessons: The Pedagogy of Imperialism in Nineteenth-Century China (Durham: Duke University Press, 2003), 150–53]。

en: At the time of this writing, there are sixteen officially recognized indigenous groups in Taiwan. P. Kerim Friedman has termed the proliferation of localism the “hegemony of the local” and refers to these subgeobodies as “fractal.” His larger argument is that redefinition of “locality” in Taiwan along ethnic lines within the population of non-Mainlanders has diffused anti-GMD nationalism by atomizing locality to the point where it becomes harmless in terms of national-scale political mobilization. Friedman asserts that such “fractal recursivity” has its origin in the Japanese colonial period. Friedman, “The Hegemony of the Local.”
zh: 截至本文写作时，台湾有十六个官方承认的原住民族群。P. 凯里姆·弗里德曼（P. Kerim Friedman）把地方主义的泛滥称为“地方的霸权”（hegemony of the local），并把这些次级地理体称为“分形的”（fractal）。他更大的论点是：台湾在非外省人口内部沿族群界线对“地方性”的重新定义，通过把地方原子化到在全国规模政治动员上变得无害的程度，分散了反国民党的民族主义。弗里德曼断言，这种“分形递归性”（fractal recursivity）起源于日本殖民时期。[Friedman, “The Hegemony of the Local”]。
